scope: offline only; no COM, no RF, no flash, no HEX, no cryptography, no keys

design.radio_calls: none; the module is pure scheduling logic and the caller supplies time, RX busy and ACK busy
design.ownership: exactly one in-flight frame with a named owning context
design.priority: immediate ACK first, then RX, then any queued transmission; application traffic never preempts either
design.ordering: round robin across contexts that have work, FIFO within a context
design.fifo_rationale: a later poll must not overtake an already submitted application frame; application frames are one shot and are never retried
design.queues: bounded per context at depth 4; overflow is an explicit refusal with a per-context counter
design.tuple_ownership: submission refuses a frame whose MAC PAN is not the context's PAN or whose MAC source short is not the context's assigned short
design.duplicate_ids: a host id already queued or in flight is refused rather than silently retransmitted
design.completion_routing: a completion must name the in-flight host id; anything else is a routing error that credits no context
design.timeout: the in-flight frame fails at its deadline, frees the radio and is never retried
design.isolation: a failure or timeout in one context leaves the other context's queue and counters untouched
design.starvation_counter: diagnostic only; it never reorders work

groups: submission validation including four cross-context tuple refusals
ACK and RX priority with separate deferral counters
serialisation: no second frame while one is in flight
round robin fairness: both contexts served equally over sustained load
FIFO within a context so a poll cannot overtake an application frame
bounded queues, explicit overflow, other context unaffected, high water recorded
completion routing, unknown host id is a routing error crediting no context
failure isolation: the healthy context keeps transmitting
deadline timeout: terminal, counted once, never retried
starvation counter is diagnostic and does not reorder

not_proven: that the scheduler's bounds suit a 60 minute soak; the session budgets in main.c are still the V25 values
